reviewDispositions.reason: The released source intentionally describes v5 and directs readers to their installed package. The installed package and manifest identify 5.2.0; generated website release badges, Markdown provenance and MCP provenance carry the exact 5.2.0 identity. No false version label remains. The paragraph states that its exact published versions identify the reproducible documentation fixture rather than every compatible application's required versions; it links Router 0.1.1's recorded source and independent validation run. The guide does not claim this fixture was rerun with core 5.2.0. Replacing its historical versions would fabricate new verification.
